SELECT 
    (COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage_without_fluorine,
    AVG(atom_count) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule,
    (SELECT AVG(bond_count) FROM (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND m.molecule_id = 'TR450' GROUP BY m.molecule_id)) AS avg_bonds_with_fluorine,
    (SELECT AVG(bond_count) FROM (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND m.molecule_id <> 'TR450' GROUP BY m.molecule_id)) AS avg_bonds_without_fluorine,
    AVG(bond_strength) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM 
    molecule m
LEFT JOIN 
    atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND a.element = 'f'
LEFT JOIN 
    (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' GROUP BY m.molecule_id) atom_counts ON m.molecule_id = atom_counts.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN 
    (SELECT b.bond_id, CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 WHEN b.bond_type = '=' THEN 2 WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN 3 END AS bond_strength FROM bond b) bond_strengths ON m.molecule_id = bond_strengths.molecule_id
WHERE 
    m.label = '+';

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)
SELECT 
    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    CASE 
        WHEN pc.percentage_c > oa.overall_average_percentage_c THEN 'Above Average'
        ELSE 'Below Average'
    END AS performance_comparison
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,
    overall_average oa;

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s1.sname, s1.AvgScrWrite, s1.CharterNum,
       COUNT(s2.AvgScrWrite) + 1 AS rank
FROM (
    SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite, sch.CharterNum
    FROM satscores s
    JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
    WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.sname IS NOT NULL AND sch.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
) AS s1
JOIN (
    SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite
    FROM satscores s
    WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
) AS s2 ON s1.AvgScrWrite < s2.AvgScrWrite OR (s1.AvgScrWrite = s2.AvgScrWrite AND s1.sname <= s2.sname)
ORDER BY s1.AvgScrWrite DESC, s1.sname;

SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) ec
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            m.molecule_id,
            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c
        JOIN 
            atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN 
            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        JOIN 
            molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE 
            a1.element < a2.element
        GROUP BY 
            m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    ) sub
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id
) max_ec ON ec.molecule_id = max_ec.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = max_ec.max_combination_count;

SELECT 
    dist.A2 AS region,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        ELSE 'Medium'
    END AS loan_size_category,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_c
FROM 
    loan l
JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE 
    l.amount < 100000
GROUP BY 
    dist.A2, 
    CASE 
        WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        ELSE 'Medium'
    END;

SELECT DISTINCT s1.sname, s1.AvgScrWrite, s1.CharterNum,
       COUNT(s2.AvgScrWrite) + 1 AS rank
FROM (
    SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite, sch.CharterNum
    FROM satscores s
    JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
    WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.sname IS NOT NULL AND sch.CharterNum IS NOT NULL

    SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite

ORDER BY s1.AvgScrWrite DESC, s1.sname;

sql:
SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) ec
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            m.molecule_id,
            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c
        JOIN 
            atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN 
            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        JOIN 
            molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE 
            a1.element < a2.element
        GROUP BY 
            m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    ) sub
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id
) max_ec ON ec.molecule_id = max_ec.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = max_ec.max_combination_count;

    dist.A2 AS region,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        ELSE 'Medium'
    END AS loan_size_category,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_c

    loan l
JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE 
    l.amount < 100000
GROUP BY 
    dist.A2, 
    CASE 
        WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        ELSE 'Medium'
    END;

SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) ec
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            m.molecule_id,
            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c
        JOIN 
            atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN 
            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        JOIN 
            molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE 
            a1.element < a2.element
        GROUP BY 
            m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    ) sub
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id
) max_ec ON ec.molecule_id = max_ec.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = max_ec.max_combination_count;

SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) ec
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            m.molecule_id,
            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c
        JOIN 
            atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN 
            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        JOIN 
            molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE 
            a1.element < a2.element
        GROUP BY 
            m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    ) sub
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id
) max_ec ON ec.molecule_id = max_ec.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = max_ec.max_combination_count;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)
SELECT 
    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    (pc.percentage_c - oa.overall_average_percentage_c) AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,
    overall_average oa;

sql:
WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
MaxCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations
    GROUP BY 
        molecule_id
),
MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        ec.molecule_id,
        ec.element1,
        ec.element2
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations ec
    JOIN 
        MaxCombinations mc ON ec.molecule_id = mc.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = mc.max_combination_count
),
MostCommonCombinationBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS most_common_combination_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    JOIN 
        MostCommonCombinations mcc ON m.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id AND a1.element = mcc.element1 AND a2.element = mcc.element2
),
TotalBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS total_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (most_common_combination_bond_count * 100.0 / total_bond_count) AS percentage
FROM 
    MostCommonCombinationBonds, TotalBonds;

SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) ec
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        sub.molecule_id,
        MAX(sub.combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            m.molecule_id,
            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c
        JOIN 
            atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN 
            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        JOIN 
            molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE 
            a1.element < a2.element
        GROUP BY 
            m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    ) sub
    GROUP BY 
        sub.molecule_id
) max_ec ON ec.molecule_id = max_ec.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = max_ec.max_combination_count;

sql:
WITH region_loan_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_count,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, 
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        region_loan_stats
)
SELECT 
    rls.region,
    rls.loan_size_category,
    rls.percentage_c,
    o.overall_average_percentage_c,
    rls.percentage_c - o.overall_average_percentage_c AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    region_loan_stats rls,
    overall_avg o;

SELECT ANY_VALUE(s1.sname) AS sname, s1.AvgScrWrite, ANY_VALUE(s1.CharterNum) AS CharterNum,
       COUNT(s2.AvgScrWrite) + 1 AS rank
FROM (
    SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite, sch.CharterNum
    FROM satscores s
    JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
    WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.sname IS NOT NULL AND sch.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
) AS s1
JOIN (
    SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite
    FROM satscores s
    WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
) AS s2 ON s1.AvgScrWrite < s2.AvgScrWrite OR (s1.AvgScrWrite = s2.AvgScrWrite AND s1.sname <= s2.sname)
GROUP BY s1.AvgScrWrite
ORDER BY s1.AvgScrWrite DESC;

    g.Country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT g.GasStationID) AS ValueForMoneyGasStationsCount
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID

            gasstations g2 ON t2.GasStationID = g2.GasStationID
        WHERE 
            g2.Country = g.Country 
            AND g2.Segment = g.Segment 
            AND t2.ProductID = t.ProductID
    )
GROUP BY 
    g.Country;

WITH AbnormalHCT AS (
    SELECT Patient.ID, Examination.HCT
    FROM Patient
    JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID

FROM AbnormalHCT
JOIN Examination ON AbnormalHCT.ID = Examination.ID
ORDER BY Examination."aCL IgA" DESC
LIMIT 1;

sql:
SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) ec
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        sub.molecule_id,
        MAX(sub.combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            m.molecule_id,
            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c
        JOIN 
            atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN 
            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        JOIN 
            molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE 
            a1.element < a2.element
        GROUP BY 
            m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    ) sub
    GROUP BY 
        sub.molecule_id
) max_ec ON ec.molecule_id = max_ec.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = max_ec.max_combination_count;

sql:
WITH region_loan_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_count,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, 
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        region_loan_stats
)
SELECT 
    rls.region,
    rls.loan_size_category,
    rls.percentage_c,
    o.overall_average_percentage_c,
    rls.percentage_c - o.overall_average_percentage_c AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    region_loan_stats rls,
    overall_avg o;

SELECT ANY_VALUE(s1.sname) AS sname, s1.AvgScrWrite, ANY_VALUE(s1.CharterNum) AS CharterNum,
       COUNT(s2.AvgScrWrite) + 1 AS rank
FROM (

    WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.sname IS NOT NULL AND sch.CharterNum IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY s1.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) ec
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        sub.molecule_id,
        MAX(sub.combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            m.molecule_id,
            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c
        JOIN 
            atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN 
            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        JOIN 
            molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE 
            a1.element < a2.element
        GROUP BY 
            m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    ) sub
    GROUP BY 
        sub.molecule_id
) max_ec ON ec.molecule_id = max_ec.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = max_ec.max_combination_count;

sql:
WITH region_loan_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_count,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, 
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        region_loan_stats
)
SELECT 
    rls.region,
    rls.loan_size_category,
    rls.percentage_c,
    o.overall_average_percentage_c,
    rls.percentage_c - o.overall_average_percentage_c AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    region_loan_stats rls,
    overall_avg o;

SELECT ANY_VALUE(s1.sname) AS sname, s1.AvgScrWrite, ANY_VALUE(s1.CharterNum) AS CharterNum,
       COUNT(s2.AvgScrWrite) + 1 AS rank
FROM (
    SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite, sch.CharterNum
    FROM satscores s
    JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
    WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.sname IS NOT NULL AND sch.CharterNum IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY s1.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) ec
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        sub.molecule_id,
        MAX(sub.combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            m.molecule_id,
            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c
        JOIN 
            atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN 
            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        JOIN 
            molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE 
            a1.element < a2.element
        GROUP BY 
            m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    ) sub
    GROUP BY 
        sub.molecule_id
) max_ec ON ec.molecule_id = max_ec.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = max_ec.max_combination_count;

WITH region_loan_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_count,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, 
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        region_loan_stats
)
SELECT 
    rls.region,
    rls.loan_size_category,
    rls.percentage_c,
    o.overall_average_percentage_c,
    rls.percentage_c - o.overall_average_percentage_c AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    region_loan_stats rls,
    overall_avg o;
